entities.summary: The Botanical Garden of Lourizán is an arboretum located in the 54 hectares grounds of the Pazo de Lourizán in the municipality of Pontevedra, Spain. With more than 850 catalogued species it is one of the largest collections in the country, and the most important botanical garden in Galicia.
